Emerson’s automation solutions help you unlock critical data, optimize your existing systems and
protect the investments you’ve already made.

## Emerson's Automation Solutions Optimize Performance

Emerson empowers you to modernize business operations at your pace, drive optimal performance and
deliver long-term operational excellence.

[icon]

From control systems to industrial software, our advanced automation solutions power connected
operations and improve performance where it matters most.

[icon]

Emerson’s global support and local experts offer deep market knowledge that minimizes business
disruption and keeps industrial operations running. 

[icon]

##### Proven Industry Expertise

Emerson brings decades of technical expertise and industry insight to solve the world’s most complex
operational challenges.

[icon]

##### Legacy of Innovations

industrial automation.

# A History of Innovation and… the pursuit of Perfect Air

Lennox (NYSE:LII) is a leading worldwide provider of climate control solutions for air conditioning,
heating, and refrigeration. We have built our business on a heritage of integrity and innovation
dating back to 1895.

[Commercial Image] [Green semi-transparent overlay used as a background effect] [Cloud] [Residential
Image] [Main Product]

[Commercial Image] [Green semi-transparent overlay used as a background effect]

## The Ultimate System for Perfect Air

The Ultimate Comfort System™ combines the best of the Dave Lennox Signature® Collection to create an
unprecedented whole-home comfort system that seamlessly and intelligently works together to stay
finely tuned to your home and deliver consistently clean, perfect air.

[Learn More][19]
2/8 [Icon Pagination]
[Cloud Top] [ UCS Product ] [Cloud Bottom]
[Learn More][20]
2/8 [Home Icon]

## Indoor Air Quality

Perfect air is about more than just how it feels, but what it contains. Lennox offers a range of
advanced air purification, filtration, humidity control and ventilation systems to help ensure the
air inside your home is as clean, healthy and comfortable as you'd like it to be.

[Start Saving][21]

[Start Saving][22]

## Lennox® Smart Thermostats

Lennox offers a suite of technologically advanced controls and zoning products designed to help you
customize the air in your home and tune your system to your personal degree of perfection.

[Explore Smart Thermostats][23]
4/8 [Icon Pagination]
[Cloud Top] [ Lennox® Smart Thermostats Alt ] [Cloud Bottom]
[Explore Smart Thermostats][24]
4/8 [Home Icon]

## Variable Refrigerant Flow

Unlock the potential of your commercial spaces with Lennox VRF – tailored to meet the diverse needs
of various structures and industries. Low sound levels make for effective classroom learning
environments, and better temperature control lets every office, common area or apartment stay
comfortable.

[Explore the full Line][25]
5/8 [Icon Pagination]
[Cloud Top] [ Variable Refrigerant Flow Product ] [Cloud Bottom]
[Explore the full Line][26]
5/8 [Home Icon]

## Air Quality

Elevate your business environment with Lennox HVAC solutions, addressing one of the top five
environmental risks identified by the U.S. EPA – poor indoor air quality (IAQ). With options that
regulate humidity levels and effectively eliminate contaminants, Lennox HVAC solutions create a
healthier workspace for your team and customers.

[Learn more][27]
6/8 [Icon Pagination]
[Cloud Top] [ Air Quality Product ] [Cloud Bottom]
[Learn more][28]
6/8 [Home Icon]

## Indoor Comfort

Elevate your commercial climate control with ComfortSense thermostats, offering a seamless and
efficient temperature management experience. Designed with advanced features, heightened application
flexibility, and energy efficiency, these commercial thermostats are tailor-made to optimize the
performance of your Lennox rooftop equipment.

[Learn More][29]
7/8 [Icon Pagination]
[Cloud Top] [ Indoor Comfort Product ] [Cloud Bottom]
[Learn More][30]

The CORE Unit Controller reinvents the service process to optimize unit operation and energy
efficiency in real-time at the touch of your fingers through The CORE Service App. See why Lennox
rooftop units, powered by the CORE Unit Controller, deliver a lower total cost of ownership when you
consider energy bills, maintenance, and unit lifetime.

# Total solutions in steam and condensate, heat transfer, hot water and humidification.

[>][18]

## Featured Products

### For more information please contact us at [sales@affiliatedsteam.com][19] or [(800)
### 424-5392][20]

 

## Coils

Affiliated Steam & Hot Water specializes in **steam, hot water, and heat transfer solutions** for a
wide range of industries, including food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, manufacturing,
healthcare, hospitality, and more.

## Paul Mueller Temp-Plate Inflated Heat Transfer Products

Temp-Plate is a proprietary heat transfer surface made by inflating gauge material. While it is
primarily used for exterior tank walls and tank heads, applications in which it can be implemented
are practically limitless.

## Bringing Net Zero Within Reach

Armstrong makes it easier for you with a Roadmap to Decarbonization, tailored for your facilities
and industry.

 

 

As the call to combat climate change gains momentum and the world moves towards decarbonization, net
zero has become our shared destination. Many companies are unsure of how to move forward and want a
pragmatic, ready-to-implement solution. Although there is a systematic methodology to
decarbonization, what’s right for one facility may be wrong for another. Armstrong is here to do
what’s right for you.

 

[Learn more about decarbonization][21]

 

Click below for more information:

 

[Roadmap to Decarbonization][22]

[Thermal Studies & Mapping][23]

[Decarbonization Products & Services][24]

[Renewable Energy Sources][25]

## Whatever your industry, we have the utility system solutions you need.

Affiliated Steam and Hot Water serves customers in a wide and varied range of industries, including:
food processing, pharmaceuticals, concrete, laundry, healthcare, education, manufacturing,
hospitality, and many more.

#### Featured Product & Promotions

### 5 Reasons why you purchase Coils from Affiliated Steam & Hot Water!
1. You Obtain Immediate Pricing and Quotations
2. You Save Expensive Labor – To – Install Dollars
3. You Save Money on Our Fast Shipment
4. You Like Our “Re-Design” Capabilities
5. You Have a Feeling of Confidence Dealing with Affiliated Steam & Hot Water

#### Featured Product & Promotions

### Control Valves

The Armstrong Python 1500 Series Control Valve, pneumatic & electric actuated, provides precision
control for repeatability and safety in your processes.  Increasing fuel costs require the most
efficient pressure and temperature control and the Armstrong Python valve offers numerous options
and accessories to meet your individual application requirements.

## Throughout the Midwest, industrial, commercial and institutional customers alike turn to us for
## the most dependable utility system solutions.

More than 60 years of in-depth knowledge and experience enables Affiliated Steam and Hot Water to
provide customers with more effective solutions than anyone else in the region.

#### Featured Video

### Emergency Heat Exchanger Replacement

Heat exchanger tube bundle replacement from the original equipment manufacturer can be costly and
have an unfortunately long lead time.
[Watch Video][45]

#### Featured Seminar

#### November 6-7, 2025

### Seminar / Northern Wisconsin

Join us in our “Live Steam Training Facility” in Alsip, Illinois. Our program features a live steam
board where you will actually see how steam works! Discussion and live demonstration includes steam
energy costs, water hammer, PRV’s, steam coils & water heaters, line sizing, trap testing,
humidifiers, and condensate pumps. For more information and to register by phone please contact us
at (708) 371-0600.

### **About Anderson-Snow Corporation**

Since 1954, ANSCOR has been meeting the needs and special requirements of our customers, fabricating
a complete line of custom and heavy duty finned tube coils. We’re your ultimate source for
industrial heating & cooling coils that can be used for new installations and retrofit. Today, we’re
recognized throughout the industry for our value, quality, and prompt delivery.

I've tried other " Industrial Heavy Duty " coils only to find out they they are nothing more that
standard HVAC coils with a slightly heavier tube. Anderson-Snow solved my coil problems by actually
supplying all welded , carbon & stainless coils... Coils that I can be use in my process equipment
without failing.

### Chris

Paper Mill Plant in Alabama
[A white background with a few lines on it]
Anderson Snow came out and field measured my coils to insure an exact dimensional replacement.They
replaced my copper tube brazed coils with all welded stainless coils. With the same fin material

### Dan

Heavy duty , exact fit coils. All welded construction with a 500# hydro-test. No longer do I have to
fix coil leaks or be down for days while I replace coils. Anderson Snow solved my leaky coil

goes down, that is valuable time and money lost. Here at Coil Company, we have developed a
detail-oriented process to ensure a perfect build each time.

quickly and accurately provide you with a quote. Follow this easy-to-use guide, and let us take care
of the rest. Here at Coil Company, we make replacing coils easy and stress-free.

intuitive and easy-to-use coil sizing program out there. Our free software generates performance and
drawings in a few easy steps. Request the software by filling out our easy-to-use form and let the
program do the rest.

## Frequently asked Questions

What is CS2Tracker?−
CS2Tracker lets you look up Counter-Strike 2 players by Steam ID/URL and view key stats like
playtime, match totals, win rate, K/D, and headshot rate - all in one place.
Which Steam IDs are supported?+
You can paste a SteamID64, custom profile URL, or vanity ID. If the player profile is private, some
stats may show as placeholders.
Why is some data missing?+
Some stats depend on Steam privacy settings and what the API provides. When data is unavailable, we
show placeholders instead of wrong numbers.
How often are stats updated?+
Updates depend on the upstream data source. Generally, you’ll see changes after Steam updates the
player stats, which can take a bit after matches.
Can I use this to detect cheaters?+
We surface signals like ban status and unusual stat patterns, but it’s not a guarantee. Use it as
context - not as proof.

What is CS2Tracker?−
CS2Tracker lets you look up Counter-Strike 2 players by Steam ID/URL and view key stats like
playtime, match totals, win rate, K/D, and headshot rate - all in one place.
Which Steam IDs are supported?+
You can paste a SteamID64, custom profile URL, or vanity ID. If the player profile is private, some
stats may show as placeholders.
Why is some data missing?+
Some stats depend on Steam privacy settings and what the API provides. When data is unavailable, we
show placeholders instead of wrong numbers.
How often are stats updated?+
Updates depend on the upstream data source. Generally, you’ll see changes after Steam updates the
player stats, which can take a bit after matches.
Can I use this to detect cheaters?+
We surface signals like ban status and unusual stat patterns, but it’s not a guarantee. Use it as
context - not as proof.

## Hot Water Coils

Efficient heating coils transferring thermal energy from hot water to air in commercial HVAC systems
for consistent warmth.

## Chilled Water Coils

Cooling coils using chilled water to absorb heat from air, maintaining ideal temperatures in
commercial spaces and systems.

## Evaporator Coils

Essential for cooling systems, these coils absorb indoor heat as refrigerant evaporates, delivering
efficient and consistent air conditioning.

## Condenser Coils

Designed for heat rejection, these coils release absorbed heat from refrigerant into the surrounding
air, ensuring cooling efficiency.

## Steam Coils

Durable coils using steam as a heat source to warm air quickly and efficiently in large-scale
commercial HVAC applications.

## Custom Coils

We provide a wide range of coil sizes, circuit layouts, and fin-to-tube designs. Choose from
multiple material options for enhanced durability, with optional protective coatings available.

## [More Heat Exchanger Manufacturers][81]


### Heat Exchanger Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with heat exchanger manufacturers that supply thermal management
equipment for HVAC, refrigeration, power generation, chemical processing, petrochemical refining,
food production, marine systems, wastewater treatment, electronics cooling, and industrial
manufacturing. Browse heat exchanger suppliers by equipment type, including shell and tube heat
exchangers, plate heat exchangers, plate and frame heat exchangers, finned tube heat exchangers, air
cooled heat exchangers, microchannel heat exchangers, direct contact units, and custom heat
exchanger packages. Use this directory to source manufacturers of heat exchangers, review
capabilities, compare product fit, and contact companies that support process heating, cooling,
condensation, recovery, and temperature control.

### Shell and Tube Heat Exchangers

Shell and tube heat exchangers move one fluid through tube bundles while another fluid circulates
through the surrounding shell, making them well suited for high-pressure, high-temperature service
in chemical plants, refineries, power facilities, marine systems, and heavy industrial processing.
Buyers often compare this style when they need durable construction, broad material options, and
strong performance with demanding fluids.

### Plate and Frame Heat Exchanger Systems

Plate heat exchanger manufacturers produce compact units built from stacked metal plates that create
narrow flow channels for efficient heat transfer. Plate and frame heat exchanger manufacturers are
often sourced for HVAC systems, food and beverage processing, pharmaceutical production,
refrigeration, and clean-fluid applications where space savings, access for cleaning, and thermal
efficiency matter.

### Finned Tube and Air Cooled Heat Exchangers

Finned tube heat exchangers and air cooled heat exchangers use extended surface area to transfer
heat between process fluids and moving air. These systems serve power generation, oil and gas
processing, industrial cooling, refrigeration, and facilities where water use must be reduced or
where outdoor installation is preferred.

### Specialty and Custom Heat Exchanger Designs

Microchannel heat exchangers, plate fin heat exchangers, pillow plate heat exchangers, scraped
surface units, and direct contact designs support more specialized heat exchanger manufacturing
needs. They are used in automotive cooling, electronics, cryogenics, dairy processing, brewing,
wastewater treatment, gas processing, and applications involving compact footprints, viscous
products, fouling concerns, or direct thermal contact.

### Industries That Use Heat Exchangers

HVAC and refrigeration buyers need heat exchangers that support cooling loops, condensers,
evaporators, and energy recovery systems. Chemical and petrochemical plants require
corrosion-resistant equipment for reactors, distillation, preheating, and process stream cooling.
Power generation facilities use condensers, feedwater heaters, and thermal recovery systems built
for pressure and reliability. Food and beverage processors need sanitary plate or scraped surface
designs for pasteurization, fermentation, and cooling. Marine, automotive, wastewater, electronics,
and natural gas operations rely on heat exchanger suppliers for engine cooling, desalination,
effluent recovery, heat sinks, and liquefaction support.

### Sizing and Throughput Considerations

When comparing heat exchanger manufacturers, start with production volume, heat duty, flow rate,
pressure drop, and required throughput. A low-volume process may need a compact or modular unit,
while continuous industrial production may require rugged equipment with higher capacity, redundant
operation, or custom-engineered heat exchanger packages.

### Process Fluid and Material Compatibility

Process type should guide the search. Clean fluids may work well in plate heat exchangers, while
high-pressure, corrosive, viscous, or fouling-prone fluids may require shell and tube, scraped
surface, specialty alloy, coated, or easily serviceable designs. Material compatibility, temperature
range, and maintenance access should be reviewed before requesting quotes.

### Integration and Installation Requirements

Integration is another major buying factor. Evaluate footprint, orientation, piping connections,
controls, cleaning access, installation environment, and compatibility with existing pumps,
chillers, boilers, reactors, or production lines. The best heat exchanger supplier will help match
equipment to the system instead of treating the unit as a standalone purchase.

### Inspection, Certification, and Supplier Evaluation

Inspection and certification requirements can influence supplier choice. Ask about ASME, TEMA, ISO,
PED, sanitary standards, pressure testing, documentation, weld quality, traceability, and
maintenance support when these requirements apply. To evaluate supplier specialization, compare
industry experience, product range, custom design capabilities, technical support, lead times,
replacement parts, and whether the manufacturer has solved similar heating exchanger or cooling
challenges.

### FAQ

#### How do I find heat exchanger manufacturers for my application?

Start by identifying the equipment type, fluid properties, temperature range, pressure rating, and
industry standards your process requires. Then compare heat exchanger suppliers that specialize in
those conditions rather than choosing only by price. A directory helps you browse multiple
manufacturers of heat exchangers, review capabilities, and request quotes from companies that match
your application.

#### What is the difference between plate heat exchanger manufacturers and shell and tube suppliers?

Plate heat exchanger manufacturers typically focus on compact, efficient designs for clean fluids,
HVAC, refrigeration, sanitary processing, and applications needing easy maintenance. Shell and tube
suppliers usually support higher pressure, higher temperature, heavy-duty, and more aggressive
industrial processes. The right choice depends on fluid type, fouling risk, pressure drop, cleaning
needs, and available installation space.

## [More Heat Exchanger Manufacturers][81]


### Heat Exchanger Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with heat exchanger manufacturers that supply thermal management
equipment for HVAC, refrigeration, power generation, chemical processing, petrochemical refining,
food production, marine systems, wastewater treatment, electronics cooling, and industrial
manufacturing. Browse heat exchanger suppliers by equipment type, including shell and tube heat
exchangers, plate heat exchangers, plate and frame heat exchangers, finned tube heat exchangers, air
cooled heat exchangers, microchannel heat exchangers, direct contact units, and custom heat
exchanger packages. Use this directory to source manufacturers of heat exchangers, review
capabilities, compare product fit, and contact companies that support process heating, cooling,
condensation, recovery, and temperature control.

### Shell and Tube Heat Exchangers

Shell and tube heat exchangers move one fluid through tube bundles while another fluid circulates
through the surrounding shell, making them well suited for high-pressure, high-temperature service
in chemical plants, refineries, power facilities, marine systems, and heavy industrial processing.
Buyers often compare this style when they need durable construction, broad material options, and
strong performance with demanding fluids.

### Plate and Frame Heat Exchanger Systems

Plate heat exchanger manufacturers produce compact units built from stacked metal plates that create
narrow flow channels for efficient heat transfer. Plate and frame heat exchanger manufacturers are
often sourced for HVAC systems, food and beverage processing, pharmaceutical production,
refrigeration, and clean-fluid applications where space savings, access for cleaning, and thermal
efficiency matter.

### Finned Tube and Air Cooled Heat Exchangers

Finned tube heat exchangers and air cooled heat exchangers use extended surface area to transfer
heat between process fluids and moving air. These systems serve power generation, oil and gas
processing, industrial cooling, refrigeration, and facilities where water use must be reduced or
where outdoor installation is preferred.

### Specialty and Custom Heat Exchanger Designs

Microchannel heat exchangers, plate fin heat exchangers, pillow plate heat exchangers, scraped
surface units, and direct contact designs support more specialized heat exchanger manufacturing
needs. They are used in automotive cooling, electronics, cryogenics, dairy processing, brewing,
wastewater treatment, gas processing, and applications involving compact footprints, viscous
products, fouling concerns, or direct thermal contact.

### Industries That Use Heat Exchangers

HVAC and refrigeration buyers need heat exchangers that support cooling loops, condensers,
evaporators, and energy recovery systems. Chemical and petrochemical plants require
corrosion-resistant equipment for reactors, distillation, preheating, and process stream cooling.
Power generation facilities use condensers, feedwater heaters, and thermal recovery systems built
for pressure and reliability. Food and beverage processors need sanitary plate or scraped surface
designs for pasteurization, fermentation, and cooling. Marine, automotive, wastewater, electronics,
and natural gas operations rely on heat exchanger suppliers for engine cooling, desalination,
effluent recovery, heat sinks, and liquefaction support.

### Sizing and Throughput Considerations

When comparing heat exchanger manufacturers, start with production volume, heat duty, flow rate,
pressure drop, and required throughput. A low-volume process may need a compact or modular unit,
while continuous industrial production may require rugged equipment with higher capacity, redundant
operation, or custom-engineered heat exchanger packages.

### Process Fluid and Material Compatibility

Process type should guide the search. Clean fluids may work well in plate heat exchangers, while
high-pressure, corrosive, viscous, or fouling-prone fluids may require shell and tube, scraped
surface, specialty alloy, coated, or easily serviceable designs. Material compatibility, temperature
range, and maintenance access should be reviewed before requesting quotes.

### Integration and Installation Requirements

Integration is another major buying factor. Evaluate footprint, orientation, piping connections,
controls, cleaning access, installation environment, and compatibility with existing pumps,
chillers, boilers, reactors, or production lines. The best heat exchanger supplier will help match
equipment to the system instead of treating the unit as a standalone purchase.

### Inspection, Certification, and Supplier Evaluation

Inspection and certification requirements can influence supplier choice. Ask about ASME, TEMA, ISO,
PED, sanitary standards, pressure testing, documentation, weld quality, traceability, and
maintenance support when these requirements apply. To evaluate supplier specialization, compare
industry experience, product range, custom design capabilities, technical support, lead times,
replacement parts, and whether the manufacturer has solved similar heating exchanger or cooling
challenges.

### FAQ

#### How do I find heat exchanger manufacturers for my application?

Start by identifying the equipment type, fluid properties, temperature range, pressure rating, and
industry standards your process requires. Then compare heat exchanger suppliers that specialize in
those conditions rather than choosing only by price. A directory helps you browse multiple
manufacturers of heat exchangers, review capabilities, and request quotes from companies that match
your application.

#### What is the difference between plate heat exchanger manufacturers and shell and tube suppliers?

Plate heat exchanger manufacturers typically focus on compact, efficient designs for clean fluids,
HVAC, refrigeration, sanitary processing, and applications needing easy maintenance. Shell and tube
suppliers usually support higher pressure, higher temperature, heavy-duty, and more aggressive
industrial processes. The right choice depends on fluid type, fouling risk, pressure drop, cleaning
needs, and available installation space.

HX Coils, dba Maiocco & Associates, is your #1 source for heat transfer equipment. We will meet you

cooling coils, shell and tube heat exchangers, plate and frame heat exchangers, tube bundles, and
duct heaters for all industrial and HVAC process systems. Our alliance with the best equipment
manufacturers coupled with our own technical service and support is why leading engineering firms
and facility engineering teams have been using us for over 30 years.

### [Coils][63]

We specialize in the design of new and replacement of steam coils, hot water coils, heating coils,
chilled water coils, Dx coils, and condenser coils for all industrial and HVAC process systems.

[][64]

We offer a full line of high performance Marlo Stratomizer dampered face and bypass coils in both
horizontal and vertical units, that provide superior freeze protection and positive condensate
drainage.

[][66]

### [Tube Bundles][67]

We offer a full line of custom built replacement steam-to-water, water-to-water tube bundles and
tank heater bundles for all industrial and HVAC process systems.

[][68]

### [Heat Exchangers][69]

HX Coils offers a full line of shell and tube heat exchangers, instantaneous water heaters, and
plate frame heat exchangers for industrial and HVAC process systems.

[][70]

### [Industrial Grade Heat Exchangers][71]

We now carry the Anderson Snow line of industrial-grade heat transfer products that is ideal for the
heavy industrial manufacturing and chemical processing facilities in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and
Delaware.

[][72]

### [Air Cooled Condensers & Fluid Coolers][73]

HX Coils offers a line of MicroChannel Air Cooled Condensers and Air Cooled Fluid Coolers for
mission critical, computer room air conditioning units.

As your #1 resource for heat transfer equipment solutions, HX Coils offer a wide range of electric
duct heaters and accessories to help get the maximum performance out of your process heating or
cooling system.

We offer a full line of TAMCO dampers and damper components that are engineered to provide durable
and completely maintenance-free

# PT Indira Mitra Boiler

[PT Indira Mitra Boiler - Steam Boiler, Thermal Oil Heater, Burner Boiler]

## PT Indira Mitra Boiler – Spesialis Steam Boiler, Thermal Oil Heater dan Burner Industri

[**PT Indira Mitra Boiler**][52] merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang fabrikasi, penjualan,
instalasi, service dan penyediaan spare part untuk kebutuhan sistem pemanas industri di Indonesia.
Kami menyediakan berbagai solusi pemanasan industri mulai dari [Steam Boiler,][53] [Thermal Oil
Heater][54], [Hot Water Boiler,][55] [Gas Burner][56], [Oil Burner][57], hingga sistem perpipaan dan
aksesoris boiler untuk berbagai sektor industri.

Didukung tim teknis berpengalaman, kami melayani kebutuhan industri makanan dan minuman, tekstil,
kertas, kelapa sawit, plywood, aspal, kimia, farmasi, rumah sakit, pabrik pengolahan kayu, serta
berbagai industri manufaktur lainnya. Kami juga menyediakan layanan commissioning, overhaul boiler,
retrofit burner, audit efisiensi pembakaran, serta maintenance berkala untuk meningkatkan efisiensi
energi dan menurunkan biaya operasional.

Produk dan layanan kami meliputi [Fire Tube Boiler][58], [Water Tube Boiler][59], [Thermal Oil
Heater][60], [Hot Water Boiler][61], Burner Gas LPG, Burner Solar, [Burner Dual Fuel][62], Steam
Header, Economizer, Pompa Boiler, Water Treatment Boiler serta berbagai spare part boiler dan burner
industri.

## Solusi Heating System Industri Lengkap

* [Audit Efisiensi Energi Industri][72]

## Mengapa Memilih PT Indira Mitra Boiler?

**[PT Indira Mitra Boiler][73] **memiliki pengalaman di berbagai sektor industri. Oleh karena itu,
kami mampu memberikan solusi yang tepat sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan. Kami membantu menentukan
kapasitas produksi, jenis bahan bakar, efisiensi energi, dan standar keselamatan operasional yang
sesuai.

Selain menyediakan unit baru, kami juga **[melayani troubleshooting][74] burner **dan boiler. Kami
menyediakan penggantian spare part, modifikasi sistem heating, serta konversi bahan bakar dari solar
ke gas.

Selain itu, tim kami dapat membantu meningkatkan performa pembakaran. Dengan demikian, pelanggan
dapat mengurangi konsumsi energi, menekan biaya produksi, dan meningkatkan efisiensi operasional.

# PT Indira Mitra Boiler

[PT Indira Mitra Boiler - Steam Boiler, Thermal Oil Heater, Burner Boiler]

## PT Indira Mitra Boiler – Spesialis Steam Boiler, Thermal Oil Heater dan Burner Industri

[**PT Indira Mitra Boiler**][52] merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang fabrikasi, penjualan,
instalasi, service dan penyediaan spare part untuk kebutuhan sistem pemanas industri di Indonesia.
Kami menyediakan berbagai solusi pemanasan industri mulai dari [Steam Boiler,][53] [Thermal Oil
Heater][54], [Hot Water Boiler,][55] [Gas Burner][56], [Oil Burner][57], hingga sistem perpipaan dan
aksesoris boiler untuk berbagai sektor industri.

Didukung tim teknis berpengalaman, kami melayani kebutuhan industri makanan dan minuman, tekstil,
kertas, kelapa sawit, plywood, aspal, kimia, farmasi, rumah sakit, pabrik pengolahan kayu, serta
berbagai industri manufaktur lainnya. Kami juga menyediakan layanan commissioning, overhaul boiler,
retrofit burner, audit efisiensi pembakaran, serta maintenance berkala untuk meningkatkan efisiensi
energi dan menurunkan biaya operasional.

Produk dan layanan kami meliputi [Fire Tube Boiler][58], [Water Tube Boiler][59], [Thermal Oil
Heater][60], [Hot Water Boiler][61], Burner Gas LPG, Burner Solar, [Burner Dual Fuel][62], Steam
Header, Economizer, Pompa Boiler, Water Treatment Boiler serta berbagai spare part boiler dan burner
industri.

kapasitas produksi, jenis bahan bakar, efisiensi energi, dan standar keselamatan operasional yang

KW products are only available in the shop or from certified dealers. We attach great importance to

Transparency is a top priority

Why do we charge shipping costs? Because we are transparent. We pass on the product price 1:1 to the

Putting customers first

We manufacture each suspension individually to order - exactly matching the vehicle and the wishes

FAQ

### Where is KW suspensions headquartered?

KW suspensions has its headquarters in Fichtenberg (Baden-Württemberg, Germany), together with other
well-known coilover suspension manufacturers such as [ST suspensions][12] and [ap
Sportfahrwerke][13] as well as the wheel manufacturer [BBS][14]. KW suspensions and all the other
manufacturers mentioned are subordinate to [KW automotive][15], which employs over 400 people in
Fichtenberg.

### Where can I buy KW suspensions?

On this website, you will find all the important information about our products. You can find out
about the special features of our Coilover suspensions or read about why an upgrade with KW
suspensions products is worthwhile for your specific vehicle model in our [KW suspensions vehicle
world][16]. Once you have decided which product is right for you, you can easily purchase it via our
[KW suspensions online shop][17].

### Can I also buy shock absorbers from KW suspensions?

No. At the moment, the sale of classic shock absorbers as spare parts is not yet possible at KW
suspensions. We will of course inform you when we have shock absorbers in our programme!

customers with road vehicles, but also in renowned racing series all over the world. They rely on

# WE ARE HEATCRAFT COILS

At Heatcraft^{®} Coils, we take FORM, FIT, and FUNCTION to the next level. Our Heatcraft^{®} heat
transfer brand is well-recognized globally for quality construction, exact fit, and long-life
operation. Our team of experts are skilled engineers and craftsmen who have the experience,
capabilities, and facilities to turn your order quickly and efficiently. From 6” to a massive 410”
coil for OEM or Replacement, your coil order is ours from order to installation.

#### Find Your Coil at Heatcraft Coils!

Heatcraft^{®} works closely with Original Equipment Manufactures providing full design and
engineering services throughout the development process of specific and unique coils.

Heatcraft^{®} works closely with Specifying Engineers providing design services and coils for
Commercial, Residential, Institutional or Industrial construction projects.

[ Read More ][38]
[Aftermarket_home_thumb]

### [Aftermarket / Replacement][39]

Heatcraft^{®} works closely with Contractors, Owners, Plan/Spec and Design/Build firms providing
“made to fit” emergency and planned retrofit heat exchangers.

[ Read More ][40]

## Fit • Form • Function

It’s why Heatcraft^{®} Coils is your best coil solution.

We are your commercial and industrial solutions specialists. Every product we make is custom
designed to your exact specifications for the coil we will be replacing or building for the first
time. Our experienced sales reps will help you correctly measure and determine the right coil
dimensions for your HVAC/R needs. There are many new options available today, so replacing a coil
with the same design may not be what’s best for you.


## Protect Expensive HVAC/R Equipment

Major OEMs recommend ElectroFin^{®} E-Coat & Insitu^{®} Spray Applied Coating as the premier choice
for corrosion protection.

legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications

hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

trust.

# Enhance Player Experience

## Steam's unique set of services goes beyond the standard product offering of PC game launchers,
## increasing customer engagement and satisfaction.

[ Steam overlay

An in-game interface that allows your players to access a variety of community features—like
user-made guides, Steam chat, achievement progress, and more.

Read Documentation → ][36] [ Instant Screenshots

community.

Read Documentation → ][37] [ User-created guides

moments, explaining complex economies, or solving puzzles.

Read Documentation → ][38] [ Live streams

development, or simply engage with your community.

Read Documentation → ][39] [ Cloud saves

Steam Cloud can automatically store save files on our servers—so players can resume their game no
matter where they are.

Read Documentation → ][40] [ Profile customization

Play.

game.

# Gameplay Features

## We've built the groundwork for a wide variety of gameplay features so you don't have to. Adding
## them to your game is simple with the Steamworks API.
## Please refer to the [Feature Documentation][44] for more details.

### Basic Features

Games of most genres will benefit from these features, which address basic needs. Steamworks API
integration is required, but fairly easy to implement.

[ Achievements

Players expect in-game achievements. Use them to reward dedicated fans, mark special events, and
encourage particular activities.

Read Documentation → ][45] [ Game Statistics

Analyze in-game behavior to let players track their own progress and compare it to other players.

Read Documentation → ][46] [ Leaderboards

Rank player progress and skill globally and among their friends—with dozens, hundreds, or thousands
of individual leaderboards.

Read Documentation → ][47] [ Game servers

Create and host dedicated servers yourself or allow your community to host them.

Read Documentation → ][48] [ Game notifications

Automatically notify players who are waiting to take a turn or join a multiplayer match when they've
got to get back to the game.

Read Documentation → ][49] [ OpenID

Safely connect to Steam via OpenID for a range of useful services that you can utilize on your
website or in-game.

Read Documentation → ][50] [ Steam Voice

Enable voice chats and voice commands directly inside your game, without the need for third-party
software.

Read Documentation → ][51] [ Rich presence

Steam users can see a richer depiction of what their friends are doing in your game, making for a
more enticing call to action.

Read Documentation → ][52] [ DDoS Protection

Our networking backbone authenticates users and limits attackers' ability to disrupt your
multiplayer servers.

Read Documentation → ][53]

### Advanced Features

Deepen the functionality of your game with these high-value features, which require more effort to
implement but will pay dividends.

Steam Workshop

Integrate player-created content into your game. You control how mods interact with your game, while
Steam handles the hosting, tracking, updates, and payment process.

[Read Documentation →][54]

The [Cities Skylines][55] community has taken city planning into their own hands, with 170,000+
custom mods uploaded.

[Browse the Cities Skylines Workshop →][56]

In [Rust][57], new mods are voted on by the community before being brought into the game, designers
get revenue and credit.

[Browse the Rust Workshop →][58] Steam Input

Configure your in-game actions with Steam Input to enable players to easily use a variety of popular
control devices and customize inputs to their liking.

[Read Documentation →][59]

#### Controller Gaming on PC

A deep dive into controller usage on Steam and the benefits of optimizing.

[Read the Steam Report →][60] Inventory Service

We've solved the hard back-end problems to enable you to get a complex persistent player inventory
up and running faster.

[Read Documentation →][61] Microtransactions

Process in-game transactions simply, safely, and hassle-free, with Steam microtransaction services
built on our strong e-commerce platform supporting 80 payment methods across 39 currencies.

[Read Documentation →][62] Matchmaking and lobbies

Take advantage of Steam matchmaking and multiplayer lobbies, so you can focus on your gameplay. Our
system lets players create, search, share, and join lobbies as desired, and supports skill-based
matchmaking.

[Read Documentation →][63]

## A Leader in High-Quality HVAC/R Heat Transfer Products for Replacement, OEM, and Design Build

[Contact Us][55]

## Custom Coils for Replacement, OEM, and Design Build

[Our Products][56]

Precision Coils is an HVAC/R custom coil manufacturer with a complete line of standard and
custom-built coils, all of which can be made to customers’ precise dimensions and material
preferences. Special fin materials and measurements, custom crating, and stainless-steel casings are
some of the many customization options available. Precision Coils combines expert craftsmanship with
responsive customer service to offer expedited lead times from 1 to 15 days, along with some of the
fastest standard lead times in the industry.

## Replacement Coils with Rapid Lead Times

Precision Coils’ Quick Build program enables customers to rapidly order replacement coils. Using our
expertise as an HVAC/R coil manufacturer, our team works with you to obtain the relevant
measurements and performance requirements, building your replacement coil with lead times as fast as
one day.

[Quick Build Program][57]

## High-Quality HVAC/R Coils Utilized Across Industries

### View the full scope of Precision Coils’ industrial applications.

Throughout Precision Coils’ 25-year history as an HVAC coil manufacturer, our replacement, OEM, and
design-build coils have been utilized in HVAC/R systems throughout numerous industries and
workplaces, including schools, hospitals, and data centers.

[Industries][58]

## Experience the Precision Coils Difference

Over the past 25 years, we’ve carefully honed our manufacturing of premium replacement, OEM, and
design-build HVAC/R coils, all while building our reputation for rapid lead times, competitive
pricing, and exceptional customer service. Few HVAC/R coil suppliers can compete with [Precision
Coils’ Quick Build program][59] or our [industry-preferred coil selection software][60], confirming
our status as a leading coil replacement company.

Precision Coils stands out from the competition through several key factors:

#### 99 %

Customer Retention

99% of our customers choose to continue partnering with Precision Coils, indicating the excellence
of our service and products.

#### # 1

Selection Software

Our PC Select software is the preferred coil selection program throughout the industry for its
accuracy, speed, and ease of use.

#### 97 %

On-Time Ship Rate

Precision Coils ships 97% of orders on or before the promised date to help clients avoid delays and
finish projects on schedule.

## Built for Performance and Proven by Professionals

> a lot of our time. ” Sandy Yu Western Allied Mechanical

# Custom Coil Manufacturer Providing Fast,
# Exceptional Service

## A Leader in High-Quality HVAC/R Heat Transfer Products for Replacement, OEM, and Design Build

[Contact Us][55]

## Custom Coils for Replacement, OEM, and Design Build

[Our Products][56]

Precision Coils is an HVAC/R custom coil manufacturer with a complete line of standard and
custom-built coils, all of which can be made to customers’ precise dimensions and material
preferences. Special fin materials and measurements, custom crating, and stainless-steel casings are
some of the many customization options available. Precision Coils combines expert craftsmanship with
responsive customer service to offer expedited lead times from 1 to 15 days, along with some of the
fastest standard lead times in the industry.

## Replacement Coils with Rapid Lead Times

Precision Coils’ Quick Build program enables customers to rapidly order replacement coils. Using our
expertise as an HVAC/R coil manufacturer, our team works with you to obtain the relevant
measurements and performance requirements, building your replacement coil with lead times as fast as
one day.

[Quick Build Program][57]

## High-Quality HVAC/R Coils Utilized Across Industries

### View the full scope of Precision Coils’ industrial applications.

Throughout Precision Coils’ 25-year history as an HVAC coil manufacturer, our replacement, OEM, and
design-build coils have been utilized in HVAC/R systems throughout numerous industries and
workplaces, including schools, hospitals, and data centers.

[Industries][58]

## Experience the Precision Coils Difference

Over the past 25 years, we’ve carefully honed our manufacturing of premium replacement, OEM, and
design-build HVAC/R coils, all while building our reputation for rapid lead times, competitive
pricing, and exceptional customer service. Few HVAC/R coil suppliers can compete with [Precision
Coils’ Quick Build program][59] or our [industry-preferred coil selection software][60], confirming
our status as a leading coil replacement company.

Precision Coils stands out from the competition through several key factors:

#### 99 %

Customer Retention

99% of our customers choose to continue partnering with Precision Coils, indicating the excellence
of our service and products.

#### # 1

Selection Software

Our PC Select software is the preferred coil selection program throughout the industry for its
accuracy, speed, and ease of use.

#### 97 %

On-Time Ship Rate

Precision Coils ships 97% of orders on or before the promised date to help clients avoid delays and
finish projects on schedule.

## Built for Performance and Proven by Professionals 

> “We specify Precision Coils for most of our projects. I like the selection program which allows me
> to fine-tune the performance myself instead of going back and forth with the sales rep. That saves
> a lot of our time. ” Sandy Yu Western Allied Mechanical

> “Precision Coils computer performance and pricing program is the best I've ever used. The prices
> are competitive and shipping is always on time, or early.” Patrick H. Green JMB & Associates, LLC

> “Precision Coils' Software and Pricing Program is easy to use as well as comprehensive.” Rick
> Eierdam Eierdam & Associates, Inc.

> “The folks at Precision Coils have responded quickly to technical questions and their shipments
> have been as promised. These are important fundamentals on fast track projects.” C.W. Coward

# CS:GO LEGACY

Bringing the Legend back to Life

Valve shut down CS:GO servers, but the classic is alive. Our independent Game Coordinator emulator
restores the original network stack: working lobbies, ranks, inventory with drops, and matchmaking.

[Download Client][7][Support the project][8]

## Latest News

[All News ][9]

## Project Features

All the necessary tools to revive the original gaming experience

### Matchmaking Returns

Original 5v5 matchmaking is back. Competitive 5v5, Wingman 2v2, Danger Zone, and all classic vanilla
modes on our servers.

### Inventory, Drops & Prime

Earn skins, cases and graffiti at the end of matches. Get Prime status to unlock drops and play
ranked games.

### Anticheat & Trust

Secure authorization stack with file integrity verification and anti-tamper scans for fair play.

### Dedicated Servers

Our own network of game servers, we strive to provide the best gaming quality.

### Ranks and Titles

Full rating integration. Calibrate, win, and get ranks from Silver to Global.

### Steam Authorization

Simple one-click login via Steam OpenID. Secure, convenient, and linked to your game account.

## How to Start Playing?

Three simple steps to your first match in your favorite game

01

### Download the game via Steam

Open the CS:GO page in Steam Store and add it to your library.

[Steam Store Page][10]
02

### Install our client

Download our client from the website and replace the game files.

[Download Client][11]
03

### Into the Game!

Launch the Legacy client and click 'Find Game'.

# CS:GO LEGACY

Bringing the Legend back to Life

Valve shut down CS:GO servers, but the classic is alive. Our independent Game Coordinator emulator
restores the original network stack: working lobbies, ranks, inventory with drops, and matchmaking.

[Download Client][7][Support the project][8]

## Latest News

[All News ][9]

## Project Features

All the necessary tools to revive the original gaming experience

### Matchmaking Returns

Original 5v5 matchmaking is back. Competitive 5v5, Wingman 2v2, Danger Zone, and all classic vanilla
modes on our servers.

### Inventory, Drops & Prime

Earn skins, cases and graffiti at the end of matches. Get Prime status to unlock drops and play
ranked games.

### Anticheat & Trust

Secure authorization stack with file integrity verification and anti-tamper scans for fair play.

### Dedicated Servers

Our own network of game servers, we strive to provide the best gaming quality.

### Ranks and Titles

Full rating integration. Calibrate, win, and get ranks from Silver to Global.

### Steam Authorization

Simple one-click login via Steam OpenID. Secure, convenient, and linked to your game account.

## How to Start Playing?

Three simple steps to your first match in your favorite game

01

### Download the game via Steam

Open the CS:GO page in Steam Store and add it to your library.

[Steam Store Page][10]
02

### Install our client

Download our client from the website and replace the game files.

[Download Client][11]
03

### Into the Game!

Launch the Legacy client and click 'Find Game'.

Our quality policy for guaranteeing customers’ safety. REACH is constantly striving to ensure the
highest quality of goods.

### Radiator

ISO14001 & IATF16949
* Various patents related to automotive radiators, including mold structures, connection devices,
  and inspection jigs.
* Tools and equipment for radiator performance testing and production process improvement.
* Innovative designs of radiator water chambers and their components, such as bends and overflow
  pipes.
* Radiator components with new materials or structures, such as anti-torque reinforced buckles and
  deformation volume design.
* Specialized tools for radiator assembly, packaging and air tightness testing.
* Radiator design and structure optimization for trucks and construction machinery.

### Condensor

IATF 16949
* Highly efficient cascading heat sink designed to enhance the thermal performance of the condenser.
* Design of condenser U-side plates, which may involve structural optimization.
* Innovative structures for condensers in automotive air conditioning systems to improve overall
  performance.
* Development of indented flat tubes that may enhance the hydrodynamic properties of condensers.

### AC Compressor

Multiple Levels
* New car water tank air tightness testing tool
* Plate oil cooler assembly tooling
* Oil cooler air tightness detection device
* Car radiator packaging structure
* Oil cooler water inspection and testing equipment
* Plate oil cooler rapid inspection tool

### Radiator

ISO14001 & IATF16949
* Various patents related to automotive radiators, including mold structures, connection devices,
  and inspection jigs.
* Tools and equipment for radiator performance testing and production process improvement.
* Innovative designs of radiator water chambers and their components, such as bends and overflow
  pipes.
* Radiator components with new materials or structures, such as anti-torque reinforced buckles and
  deformation volume design.
* Specialized tools for radiator assembly, packaging and air tightness testing.
* Radiator design and structure optimization for trucks and construction machinery.

### Condensor

IATF 16949
* Highly efficient cascading heat sink designed to enhance the thermal performance of the condenser.
* Design of condenser U-side plates, which may involve structural optimization.
* Innovative structures for condensers in automotive air conditioning systems to improve overall
  performance.
* Development of indented flat tubes that may enhance the hydrodynamic properties of condensers.

### AC Compressor

Multiple Levels
* New car water tank air tightness testing tool
* Plate oil cooler assembly tooling
* Oil cooler air tightness detection device
* Car radiator packaging structure
* Oil cooler water inspection and testing equipment
* Plate oil cooler rapid inspection tool

平台特色

## 不只是游戏商店，更是玩家家园

Steam为你提供从游戏购买到社交互动的完整生态，让每一段游戏旅程都更精彩。

### 海量正版游戏库

数万款游戏，涵盖3A大作、独立精品、热门网游、经典怀旧。每日更新，智能推荐帮你发现下一款挚爱游戏。

### 超值特卖与折扣

夏季特卖、冬季特卖、春节特卖、周中优惠，全年不断。低至1折的史低价格，让你用最实惠的价格体验更多好游
戏。

### 创意工坊 · 玩家创作

海量玩家自制内容，从MOD模组到地图皮肤，让游戏永不过时。创作者还能获得收益分成，鼓励更多优秀内容诞生
。

### 全球玩家社区

好友系统、游戏群组、语音通话、游戏内重叠界面。与全球玩家一起联机、讨论、分享，让游戏不再孤单。

### 云存档与成就系统

游戏进度云端自动保存，换设备无缝衔接。丰富的成就系统记录游戏历程，与好友比拼成就点数，增添更多挑战乐
趣。

### Steam Deck 掌机生态

Steam Deck便携游戏掌机，随时随地畅玩你的Steam游戏库。无缝同步进度，让游戏不再局限于桌面。

常见问题

## 关于Steam，你想知道的都在这里

以下是玩家最常咨询的问题，如果仍有疑问欢迎联系客服团队。

Steam账号如何注册？

访问Steam官网或客户端点击"登录/注册"，选择"创建新账户"，填写邮箱、密码并完成验证即可。注册后即可享受
所有功能，包括购买游戏、加入社区等。

Steam游戏支持退款吗？

Steam提供自助退款服务。在购买游戏后14天内，且游戏时长不超过2小时的情况下，可以无条件退款，退款金额将
返回原支付渠道。

Steam特卖活动多久一次？

Steam每年举办四次大型季节性特卖（春、夏、秋、冬），其中夏季特卖和冬季特卖最为盛大。此外还有每周特惠
、发行商周末、节日特卖等不间断活动。

创意工坊是什么？

创意工坊是Steam的玩家创作平台，支持游戏MOD、地图、皮肤、道具等玩家自制内容的上传与分享。玩家可以免费
下载或购买创意工坊内容，部分创作者还能获得收入分成。

Steam Deck是什么？

Steam Deck是Valve推出的便携式游戏掌机，可以畅玩Steam游戏库中的数千款游戏。采用定制AMD APU，搭载Steam
OS系统，支持掌机、桌面、电视三种模式。

如何联系Steam客服？

你可以通过Steam帮助中心提交工单，或通过Steam客户端内的"帮助"入口联系客服团队。客服会尽快响应你的问题
，提供专业、及时的帮助。

来自世界各地玩家的真实反馈，Steam是无数人游戏旅程的起点。

## 关于Steam，你想知道的都在这里

以下是玩家最常咨询的问题，如果仍有疑问欢迎联系客服团队。

Steam账号如何注册？

访问Steam官网或客户端点击"登录/注册"，选择"创建新账户"，填写邮箱、密码并完成验证即可。注册后即可享受
所有功能，包括购买游戏、加入社区等。

Steam游戏支持退款吗？

Steam提供自助退款服务。在购买游戏后14天内，且游戏时长不超过2小时的情况下，可以无条件退款，退款金额将
返回原支付渠道。

Steam特卖活动多久一次？

Steam每年举办四次大型季节性特卖（春、夏、秋、冬），其中夏季特卖和冬季特卖最为盛大。此外还有每周特惠
、发行商周末、节日特卖等不间断活动。

创意工坊是什么？

创意工坊是Steam的玩家创作平台，支持游戏MOD、地图、皮肤、道具等玩家自制内容的上传与分享。玩家可以免费
下载或购买创意工坊内容，部分创作者还能获得收入分成。

Steam Deck是什么？

Steam Deck是Valve推出的便携式游戏掌机，可以畅玩Steam游戏库中的数千款游戏。采用定制AMD APU，搭载Steam
OS系统，支持掌机、桌面、电视三种模式。

如何联系Steam客服？

你可以通过Steam帮助中心提交工单，或通过Steam客户端内的"帮助"入口联系客服团队。客服会尽快响应你的问题
，提供专业、及时的帮助。

Steam提供自助退款服务。在购买游戏后14天内，且游戏时长不超过2小时的情况下，可以无条件退款，退款金额将
返回原支付渠道。

Steam特卖活动多久一次？

Steam每年举办四次大型季节性特卖（春、夏、秋、冬），其中夏季特卖和冬季特卖最为盛大。此外还有每周特惠
、发行商周末、节日特卖等不间断活动。

创意工坊是什么？

创意工坊是Steam的玩家创作平台，支持游戏MOD、地图、皮肤、道具等玩家自制内容的上传与分享。玩家可以免费
下载或购买创意工坊内容，部分创作者还能获得收入分成。

Steam Deck是什么？

Steam Deck是Valve推出的便携式游戏掌机，可以畅玩Steam游戏库中的数千款游戏。采用定制AMD APU，搭载Steam
OS系统，支持掌机、桌面、电视三种模式。

如何联系Steam客服？

你可以通过Steam帮助中心提交工单，或通过Steam客户端内的"帮助"入口联系客服团队。客服会尽快响应你的问题
，提供专业、及时的帮助。

## If it has to be perfect, it has to be

# Super

For nearly 100 years, Super Radiator Coils has been living up to its name. We don’t just deliver
products, we deliver superior expertise, reliability and quality. So, whether it’s a coil, a
delivery, or just a phone call—it has to be Super.

[Explore our products][72]

## Excellence, Engineered. 

Excellence is one of [SRC's 5 Core Values][73], and below is a rotating showcase of projects and
capabilities that we feel demonstrate the standard we strive for. [Touch base with us][74] to learn
more.

[large industrial coil assembly with housing]

> **Slide-in steam coil**
> 
> These coils were sold to a large EPC firm for use in an activated carbon plant. The housing
> involved spec painting, sandblasting, & more. We chose the [finned tube][75] design for durability
> & it allows for aluminum fin at higher temps. All circuits are fully drainable.
> 
> Engineers - Brian Biskie, P.E. & Andy Burns, P.E.
> SRC Richmond

[10x13 Calspan Photo-min]

> **Hypersonic wind tunnel heat exchanger**
> 
> Among the most engineering intensive projects in the company's history, features include
> specialized stainless alloy and a custom-designed enclosure among others.
> 
> Engineer - Andy Burns, P.E.
> SRC Richmond

[DSC_1898-jpg-min]

> **Slide-in coil with unique pressurized housing**
> 
> This coil was designed to include a pressurized outer housing, which was rated up to 20 PSIG. It's
> made from 304 SS & features numerous reinforcing ribs to account for the operating pressures. 
> 
> Engineers - Brian Biskie, P.E. & Andy Burns, P.E.
> SRC Richmond

[LB_00156-1]

> **Specialized weld procedures**
> 
> We have elite welders at all our locations, but our Phoenix division is capable of some of the
> most complex weld procedures that we offer. Whether it's tricky materials like copper nickel or
> [strict code specs like welding in a cleanroom][76], we can handle that.
> 
> Engineers - SRC Phoenix

[corrosion-heat-exchanger]

> **Several corrosion protection options**
> 
> We're experts at designing against corrosion. [We can help you decide on a coating][77] for your
> equipment or if [corrosion-resistant materials][78] makes more sense. Got a tricky application?
> [We can get creative][79].
> 
> All SRC locations

## Products that work the first time and every time

Precision-made products backed by nearly a century of industry knowledge and experience. That’s our
promise to you. Because for something to leave our production floor, it has to be Super.

## Welltech Cooling Systems - FAQs

#### What types of cooling towers do you offer?

We offer a range of cooling towers including open-circuit, closed-circuit, and hybrid models. Each
type is designed to meet specific cooling needs and operational requirements.

#### How do I choose the right cooling tower for my application?

Selecting the right cooling tower depends on factors such as your cooling capacity needs, budget,
energy efficiency requirements, and environmental considerations. Contact us for personalized
recommendations based on your specific needs.

#### What is the installation process for a cooling tower?

The installation process involves preparing the site, assembling the cooling tower, connecting the
piping and electrical systems, and performing a thorough test and inspection. Our team can guide you
through each step or handle the installation for you.

#### How do I maintain my cooling tower?

Regular maintenance includes checking water quality, cleaning the tower, inspecting components for
wear, and ensuring the system operates efficiently. We offer maintenance services and support to
keep your cooling tower in optimal condition.

#### Can I get a quote for a cooling tower?

Yes, you can receive a free quote by filling out our online form or calling us directly. Provide
details about your requirements, and we’ll provide pricing and information tailored to your needs.

#### What warranties do you offer on your cooling towers?

We offer warranties on our cooling towers that cover manufacturing defects and certain components.
Details of the warranty are provided with each purchase and can be reviewed with our sales team.

#### Do you provide support and service after purchase?

Yes, we offer comprehensive support and service after purchase, including installation assistance,
maintenance, and repairs. Our team is available to address any questions or issues that may arise.

#### Where are your cooling towers manufactured?

Our cooling towers are manufactured using high-quality materials and advanced technology to ensure
durability and efficiency. We source components from reputable suppliers to meet industry standards.
